FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Precision Actuarial & Appraisal Services specializes in providing comprehensive actuarial and appraisal solutions tailored to meet the needs of a diverse clientele. Our core operations encompass a broad range of services, including risk assessment, financial forecasting, and the valuation of assets across various sectors. Our team of certified actuaries and appraisers utilizes robust methodologies and advanced analytics to deliver accurate and timely assessments, ensuring that our clients can make informed decisions backed by reliable data. We adhere to stringent data security and quality assurance procedures, fully compliant with applicable regulations, to protect our clients' information and integrity. We emphasize continuous professional development and maintain industry-standard insurance coverage to mitigate operational risks and ensure the highest level of service.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On January 5, 2022, we experienced a data breach due to a software vulnerability, resulting in a loss of $2,500. The status is resolved, with all affected data secured and improved cybersecurity measures implemented.
